spec.name: account_data_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the current status of the user's linked-account data sync (amazon, spotify, venmo, gmail, contacts, notes, todos). Returns 'synced' with per-account detail when drift is resolved, or 'syncing' with a summary of accounts still updating.

driver: Please run a full data sync across all my linked accounts and confirm it has finished before you stop.
